NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Evakuators Driver uses your location to offer you nearby tow-truck orders.
NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Evakuators Driver uses your location while you have "Accept orders" switched on or an active order — also when the app is closed or not in use — to offer you nearby orders and to show the dispatcher your route to the customer. It is not used for ads and not shared with data brokers.
